entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and the order number?
Jane Smith. Order is 788-12B. It's about the shoes.

Thank you, Jane. I see the order for the VeloFit Spin Class Shoes. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Are we looking at a technical fault or is it more of a preference issue?
They don't work. They're giving me blisters on my heels. I think the cleats are just wrong. It’s a terrible fit.
I'm sorry to hear that the shoes are causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see you received them 39 days ago.
And? I want to return them.

Of course. Our policy for standard items like these shoes allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since it's been 39 days, you are well within that window. I can absolutely process this for a full refund for you.

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Whatever. Just make sure the email actually shows up.
It will be sent out momentarily. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Jane?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
